_about: Mine and colliery names found in the two reference books, with page numbers and topic tags only (no book text). Names are detected automatically: a word printed only with a capital letter in that book, followed by Colliery/Mine/Pit/Quarry. printed_page comes from the page header when page_exact is true, otherwise it is interpolated from neighbouring pages.

books.Ramlu: Ramlu, M.A. Mine Disasters and Mine Rescue, 2nd edition. Universities Press (India), 2007.
books.Cheng: Cheng, J. (2018). Explosions in Underground Coal Mines: Risk Assessment and Control. Springer International Publishing.
